basic_profile.bio: I am a seasoned cryptocurrency enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software developer specializing in blockchain technology. I have a keen interest in financial markets and spend my evenings analyzing crypto trends and engaging in online discussions. In my free time, I enjoy strategy gaming and am an active player in online communities like EVE Online. I am married with two kids and often browse Reddit in the late evenings after my children have gone to bed.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a particular focus on blockchain technologies. I graduated with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas and have since worked in various tech startups focusing on innovative uses of blockchain. I've also self-taught myself through online courses and spend a significant amount of time reading and participating in crypto forums.
